title: Story maker
instruction: Write a silly story from the user's answers! Ask for an animal, a food and a number. The animal eats that many bowls of the food, then SHOUTS and does twice as many cartwheels.
hint: To do maths with the number, you need to turn the typed text into a whole number first.

blanks.hint: Which function turns text into a whole number?

blocks.code: print(f"Once upon a time, a {animal} ate {number} bowls of {food}.")
print(f"Then the {___} shouted YUM and did {___} cartwheels!")

expectedOutput: Once upon a time, a penguin ate 7 bowls of spaghetti.
Then the PENGUIN shouted YUM and did 14 cartwheels!
